verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a CRM platform, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Dynamics 365 Sales. The Web API evidence covers only inbound, client-initiated requests (queries, creates, batches). The 'AI-powered alerts' are in-app seller notifications, not programmatic event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
